products.name: Acid Wash Denim Tiered Shirt Dress
products.description: A light acid-wash denim shirt dress with a collar, a button front and roll-tab short sleeves. A seamed waist drops into a flared, tiered ruffle hem above the knee. Easy to wear with sneakers or sandals for brunch and weekend outings.

products.name: Sheer Floral Pom-Pom Trim Dress
products.description: A soft floral print dress in light, sheer layers, with a high button neck, long full sleeves and tiny pom-pom trims along the seams. A fitted waist flows into a full skirt. Romantic and feminine for brunch, church and garden parties.

products.name: White Watercolour Floral Skater Dress
products.description: A white sleeveless skater dress washed with a watercolour print of pink, coral and red flowers. A fitted bodice and a full, swingy skirt make it a sweet pick for parties, dates and celebrations.

products.name: Dark Denim Cami Maxi Dress
products.description: A dark indigo denim maxi dress with thin straps, a square neckline and a fitted bodice that flares into a long A-line skirt. Clean, simple and easy to dress up or down.

products.name: Denim Gold Button Pinafore Dress
products.description: A mid-blue denim pinafore dress with wide straps, a square neckline and a row of gold buttons all the way down the front. Wear it alone or layered over a tee or blouse.

products.name: Grey Gingham Collar Polo and Skirt Set
products.description: A soft grey two-piece set: a short-sleeve polo top with a gingham collar and button placket, and a matching pull-on midi skirt with a gingham drawstring. Comfortable and put-together for errands, work and weekends.

products.name: Ivory Knit Gold Button Skater Dress
products.description: An ivory textured knit dress with a mock neck, short sleeves and gold buttons on the shoulder. It fits through the body and flares into a full skirt. Elegant for church, brunch and special days.

products.name: Blue Lace Bishop Sleeve Tiered Dress
products.description: A light blue lace dress with a collar, a button front and sheer bishop sleeves. White floral lace covers the body, and the skirt ends in a tiered, scalloped hem. Beautiful for church, weddings and celebrations.

products.name: Blue Embroidered Lace Puff Sleeve Dress
products.description: A light blue dress covered in white embroidered lace flowers, with a collar, a button front and sheer puff sleeves. A fitted waist and a full skirt finish the look. Lovely for church, birthdays and events.

products.name: Red Pointelle Knit Midi Dress
products.description: A bold red midi dress in an open pointelle knit, with a round neck and short sleeves. It hugs the body and flares gently into a midi skirt. A head-turning colour for dinners and date nights.

products.name: Red Baroque Print Bustier Sundress
products.description: A white sundress with a bold red baroque tile print, a structured bustier top with a sweetheart neckline and a full skirt. Made for summer outings, vacations and parties.

products.name: Pink Shirt and Shorts Set
products.description: A pink two-piece set: a relaxed button-up shirt with elbow sleeves and a chest pocket, and matching shorts. Light and easy for weekends, vacations and hot days.

products.name: Cobalt Blue Waistcoat and Shorts Set
products.description: A cobalt blue two-piece set: a fitted sleeveless waistcoat with a button front and flap pockets, and matching tailored shorts. A sharp, bold look for outings and events.

products.name: Cream Shirt and Shorts Set
products.description: A cream two-piece set: a relaxed button-up shirt with elbow sleeves and a chest pocket, and matching shorts. Light, neutral and easy to wear on warm days.

products.name: Taupe Pebbled Top Handle Bag
products.description: A taupe pebbled top handle bag with a rounded handle, gold-tone hardware and a hoop buckle on the front, plus a small hanging tag. Roomy and polished for work and everyday.

products.name: Sage Floral Jacquard Buckle Bag
products.description: A sage green saddle-shaped bag with a floral jacquard front, a bold blue buckle, gold-tone hardware and a top handle. A pretty, ladylike bag for outings and events.

products.name: Cream Ostrich Texture Mini Bag
products.description: A cream mini top handle bag in an ostrich-texture finish, with a shimmering flap and gold-tone hardware. A small, elegant bag for weddings and dinners.
